# Angel Engine

> Every coding agent. One calm desktop.

Angel Engine is a local desktop that gathers coding agents (Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code, and similar) into one calm chat UI. It runs on your machine. It is not a hosted cloud agent orchestrator.

Canonical site: https://ag.akr.moe

## Links

- [Homepage](https://ag.akr.moe)
